mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM sys.acs_hist WHERE acs_ty_cd='AUTH_ATTEMPT' AND created_at > #{since} AND (obj_desc=#{target} OR ip_addr=#{ip})
mapper.sql: u.user_id AS "id",u.lgn_id AS "loginId",u.user_nm AS "name",u.pswd_hash AS "passwordHash", u.email_addr AS email,u.user_stts_cd AS status,u.rsgn_dt AS "resignationDate",u.pswd_chg_at AS "passwordChangedAt", u.pswd_chg_need_yn='Y' AS "passwordChangeRequired",(u.mfa_yn='Y' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_role ur JOIN sys.role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND r.use_yn='Y' AND r.admin_yn='Y')) AS "mfaRequired"
mapper.select: SELECT r.role_id FROM sys.user_role ur JOIN sys.role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY r.role_id

SELECT ,s.session_id_hash AS "sessionHash",s.csrf_token_hash AS "csrfHash" FROM sys.login_session s JOIN sys.user_info u ON u.user_id=s.user_id WHERE s.session_id_hash=#{sessionHash} AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at > #{now} AND u.user_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND (u.rsgn_dt IS NULL OR u.rsgn_dt > CAST(#{now} AS date))
mapper.update: UPDATE sys.user_info SET lgn_fail_cnt=lgn_fail_cnt+1, user_stts_cd=CASE WHEN lgn_fail_cnt+1 >=5 THEN 'LOCKED' ELSE user_stts_cd END, lock_at=CASE WHEN lgn_fail_cnt+1 >=5 THEN #{now} ELSE lock_at END WHERE user_id=#{id} AND user_stts_cd='ACTIVE'
UPDATE sys.user_info SET lgn_fail_cnt=0,last_lgn_at=#{now} WHERE user_id=#{id} AND user_stts_cd='ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys.login_session(session_id_hash,user_id,created_at,last_activity_at,expires_at,csrf_token_hash,password_change_required_yn) VALUES(#{sessionHash},#{id},#{now},#{now},#{expiresAt},#{csrfHash},CASE WHEN #{passwordChangeRequired} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END)
mapper.update: UPDATE sys.login_session SET last_activity_at=#{now},expires_at=#{expiresAt} WHERE session_id_hash=#{sessionHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now} AND last_activity_at <= #{mergeBefore}
UPDATE sys.login_session SET revoked_at=#{now} WHERE revoked_at IS NULL AND user_id=#{id}AND session_id_hash=#{sessionHash}
UPDATE sys.auth_tkn SET revoked_at=#{now} WHERE user_id=#{id} AND use_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL AND tkn_ty_cd=#{type}
mapper.select: SELECT tkn_id AS "tokenId",user_id AS id,tkn_hash AS "proofHash",expir_at AS "expiresAt",last_sent_at AS "lastSentAt",otp_fail_cnt AS failures FROM sys.auth_tkn WHERE tkn_ty_cd=#{type} AND use_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL AND preauth_id_hash=#{chainHash}AND tkn_hash=#{proofHash} ORDER BY tkn_id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sys.auth_tkn SET use_at=#{now} WHERE tkn_id=#{tokenId} AND use_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expir_at > #{now} AND otp_fail_cnt < 5
UPDATE sys.auth_tkn SET otp_fail_cnt=LEAST(5,otp_fail_cnt+1),revoked_at=CASE WHEN otp_fail_cnt+1 >=5 THEN #{now} ELSE revoked_at END WHERE tkn_id=#{tokenId}

UPDATE sys.user_info SET pswd_hash=#{passwordHash},pswd_chg_at=#{now},pswd_chg_need_yn='N',lgn_fail_cnt=0,lock_at=NULL, user_stts_cd=CASE WHEN user_stts_cd='LOCKED' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE user_stts_cd END WHERE user_id=#{id} AND user_stts_cd <> 'DISABLED' AND (rsgn_dt IS NULL OR rsgn_dt > CAST(#{now} AS date))
UPDATE sys.mail_outbox SET send_stts_cd=#{deliveryStatus},sent_at=CASE WHEN #{deliveryStatus}='SENT' THEN #{now} ELSE NULL END,last_error_cd=#{errorCode} WHERE mail_outbox_id=#{deliveryId}
